svg.text: Improved model (planned, built after the brief's)
Every record has one id: no two-part keys.
Item: one per SKU, so the SKU is its id.
StockRecord: one per item per warehouse, with
its own id. Shipments and movements point at it.
Items and warehouses meet only through
StockRecord, so there is no many-to-many link.
Shipments point at carriers by id (I1).
The brief's Product and Shipment are rebuilt
